en.bdb: Ladle, redladly bug and the cheat, -

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਰਸ ਮਿਠ ਰਸ ਮੇਲਿ ਕੈ ਛਤੀਹ ਭੋਜਨ ਹੋਨਿ ਰਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: khaT ras miTh ras mel kai chhateeh bhojan hon rasoiee|

en.bdb: Mixing various juices sweet and sour in the kitchen food is cooked of thirty-six kinds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਣਿਵਾਰ ਜਿਵਾਲੀਐ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: jevanivaar jivaaleeaai chaar varan chhia dharasan loiee|

en.bdb: The cook serves it to the people of all the four varnas and the followers of six philosophies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸਾਉ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: tirapat bhugat kar hoi jis jihabaa saau sin(j)aanai soiee|

en.bdb: He alone who having eaten has satisfied himself, can understand the taste of it,

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੜਛੀ ਸਾਉ ਨਾ ਸੰਭਲੈ ਛਤੀਹ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਜੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: kaRachhee saau naa sa(n)bhalai chhateeh bi(n)jan vich sa(n)joiee|

en.bdb: The ladle moves into all the dainty dishes of thirty-six type without knowing the taste of them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤੀ ਰਤਕ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਰਤਨਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ratee ratak naa ralai ratanaa(n) a(n)dhar haar paroiee|

en.bdb: The red ladybug cannot mix-up among rubies and jewels because the latter are used in the strings whereas the red ladybug cannot be used in this way.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਆਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun gur upadhes aaves na hoiee|

en.bdb: Having even listened to the teachings of Guru in the holy congregation the cheat who does not get inspired.
They do not obtain a place in the court of the Lord.
